description: Import an email from the connected Gmail/Outlook account into the agent's local inbox. This downloads the full message with all headers (Message-ID, In-Reply-To, References) so you can continue the thread using reply_email. Use search_emails with searchRelay=true first to find the relay UID.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

uid.description: The relay UID of the email to import (from search_emails relay results)

name: import_relay_email
